description: Cryptographically verify a Dominion signed attestation (JWS) — e.g. a trust-verdict receipt, gateway attestation, or MCP Verified badge. Stateless: checks the Ed25519 signature against Dominion's published public key (no trust in this server required). Use this to confirm a receipt another party gave you is authentic and untampered.

jws.description: The Dominion attestation as a JWS compact string (header.payload.signature)

name: verify_attestation

valid.description: Whether the Ed25519 signature is valid
